content: Tihanare Hasakaharehena Jesus
Hatyaoseta Enore Nisekohare axanekisa Jesus maharexakiti Tihanare hasakaharetene maheta.
Jesus tyaona 40-ki ferakene, 40-ki makene. Maisa kanakairare hoka hatyaoseta nakehena.
Hatyaoseta ehasakaharetyase tyoa kaoka enomana hoka nehena ihiye: — Enore ityaniya atyo hiso hoka exe sehalinai haikawatya nakairati hoka hikanakaira — nexa ihiye.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiye: — Exakerexe Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Maisa nakairati xema taita xini haliti nawenane tyaonita. Enore iraihenere tyotya xema tehitiya wenati tyaonita.

content: Hatyaoseta Tihanare noloka Jesus Jerusalém nali xeta waiyexe wenakalati nali hoka xane ekakoa Iraexatyakalati Hana maiyeho hoka iraehena ekakoa.
— Enore ityaniya hiso hoka hahalaisoaheta exaoseta. Hiyaiya, exakerexe Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Enore ite axikatya anjonai hoka kaxaiko hiso. Otokahaite hiso hakaheha kakoa hoka maisa hikijinai hekoti kawe hamokita sehalinai hiye.

content: Hoka Jesus nexa ihiye: — Iraiti tehitiya exakerexe xairatyoare tyaonita:
Hatyo najikinita Tihanare noloka Jesus hatya tyairi heno enoakiya hoka hotikisa enomana hakakoare waikohekoa, waiyexe wenati, xiyehaliti xoalini hare kahare hotikisa enomana hoka nehena:
— Hameholokoaiya nahalakoi, hawaiyityaiya natyo hoka exeharenai tyotya nisa homana — nexa Tihanare Jesus hiye.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiye: — Hiyanehetehena, Ahalakoahaliti! Iraiti Waiyexe exakere nexa:

content.text: Hawaiyehena hiyekohase Enore, exahe ekoamaniya taita hisaohena.

content: Nexa Jesus hoka hatyaoseta Tihanare halakisene hoka anjonai tyoa kaokaha enomana hoka kahinaetene.
Jesus Hahena Galiléia Nali
Hatyaoseta Jesus sema João xolatyaka hoka haikoaheta Galiléia koa xeta.
Xakore hoka maisa Nazaré nali tyaonita hoka xane wenakalati Cafarnaum nali tyaona. One Galiléia xa haliya, Zebulom, Naftali xoaha waikohera koa.
Nikare tyaona iraiti xakaisasehare Isaías iraetere akereta kawenatyaka maheta:

content.text: Zebulom, Naftali xoaha waikohera one kaloxere maniya, Jordão xa halakoiya maniya, Galiléia koa xoaha nali, majudeuneharenai tyaonitere nali.
Hatyonai atyo makaliroti koni tyaonahitaha hoka xaokanatyakalati kalorexe ite kaotyaka enomanaha. Hoka xaokanatyakalatite aokanahena makaliroti koni wainihenerenai ana.

content: Hatyo najikinita Jesus xakaihena hairaine ihiyeha. Nehena: — Xahalakihena iniyalahare xománe, Xekohaseti enokoatare okoi kalorexe tyaohena — nexa.
Jesus 4-hare Mairatyatiyenai Aoka Haomana
Hatyaoseta Jesus tona kilihijita ene one Galiléia xa hoka waiya hinamahare haximarene kakoarenai, Simão Pedro, André xoaha. Maka kakoa mairatyahitaha, mairatyatiyenai hoka.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiyeha: — Xisohena noximi hoka naotyakisa xiso hoka halitinai nolokasehare xisaona — nexa ihiyeha.
Nexa ihiyeha hoka halakisaha rotita maka kohase hiyakakala hoka xaneha Jesus xema.

Hatyaoseta Jesus jiyihitiya, maisekoneseta waiyihitiya hinamahare haximarene kakoarenai, Tiago, João xoaha, Zebedeu ityaninai. Tyaonahitaha kanowa ako hanexeha kakoa, tyomaharehenahititaha hahiyakakalaha.
Jesus kawisahene hoka halakisaha rotita hanexeha exahe hakanowaneha xoaha hoka xaneha Jesus xema.
Jesus Aotyakijita Exahe Aiyatelikihitita Halitinai

Hatyaoseta Jesus xane hakakoare Galiléia koa tonakoatya. Kaokehena wenakalati hoka aotyakisahitene xahohisakoatyakalati hanako. Iraiti waiyexe xakaita ihiyeha Xekohaseti Kalorexe Enore nalitare kaotyakene tahi. Haiyaharenai hokakiterenai aiyatelikihitita ekahehareha nonitata.

Ekakoita etahi akiti semaha hakakoare Síria koa maniya. Hatyo hiyeta halitinai kolatya hokakiterenai Jesus ana, kahare hawareharexe kahehaliti kakoarenai, tihanare kamilakoretiterenai, hatyahalitinai, wainitatereharenai exahe maetonaneharenae xoaha hoka tyotya aiyatelikihenahititene.
Hoka kahare halitinai xaneta exema Galiléia koa yerenai, Decápolis nalitarenai, Jerusalém nalitarenai, Judéia koa nalitarenai, one Jordãoxa halakoiya tarenae xoaha.
